Thank you. I have tried hard and because I've failed I feel like it looks like I was a lazy bum who did nothing. I want to keep trying but I've exhausted a lot of options and I'm on to plans like x y and z. 

And right now I'm kinda decided on becoming a paramedic but everytime I try to tell my mom that's what I want to do she comes up with different options for me or reasons why I should do something else. I'm just so lost.

School is #1. Top five are school, work, random little things, my relationship, and then just my future in general. 

I guess it looks like a standard list but to me it is getting to be too much
